senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; ברר; v. בַּר I)clear, bright, clean, pure.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 3:6">Tosef. Kil. III, 6</cite> (missing in ed. Zuckerm., v. Var. a. l.) <he>שהוא בר ובקי וכ׳</he> who is clear and well-versed in &c.
Num. R. s. 10 (ref. to ברי Prov. XXXI, 2, a. בר Ps. II, 12) the Law שהיא נקראת בר which is called bar (clear, pure, Ps. XIX, 9).—Pl. בָּרִים.
